title: CAT 2025 Question Paper (Slot 1, PYQ) - Quantitative Aptitude - Profit, Loss and Discount
subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.q: A shopkeeper offers a discount of 22% on the marked price of each chair, and gives 13 chairs to a customer for the discounted price of 12 chairs to earn a profit of 26% on the transaction. If the cost price of each chair is Rs 100, then the marked price, in rupees, of each chair is
questions.explain:
Let the Marked Price of one chair be $M$.
The customer gets 13 chairs but pays the discounted price for 12 chairs.
Selling Price = $12 \times (M \times 0.78) = 9.36M$.
The shopkeeper gives 13 chairs. Cost Price for 13 chairs = $13 \times 100 = 1300$.
Desired Profit is 26%, so Total Selling Price = $1300 \times 1.26 = 1638$.
Equating the two: $9.36M = 1638 \implies M = \frac{1638}{9.36} = 175$.
